policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: Family reunification turns on the SPONSOR as much as the applicant: subsistence, insurance and accommodation are assessed against the family, and holders of a Red-White-Red Card or EU Blue Card usually cover their family through co-insurance. One requirement carries an explicit waiver for newborns.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as sources already live in this registry.
not_extracted: The 'German prior to immigration' exemption list. The page enumerates who need not prove German, and those exemptions are conditions on other people's circumstances rather than requirements on this applicant.

requirements.label: Health insurance covering all risks, with benefits in Austria
requirements.description: The insurance must pay out in Austria, not merely exist.
requirements.source_excerpt: the third-country national must have health insurance coverage, providing benefits in austria and covering all risks.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The third-country national must have health insurance coverage, providing benefits in Austria and covering all risks.

requirements.label: Family of card holders are usually co-insured by the sponsor
requirements.description: Stated by the authority as the usual position, which is why the insurance requirement is often satisfied by the sponsor rather than the applicant.
requirements.source_excerpt: family members of “red-white-red card” holders, “eu blue card” holders or family members of austrian citizens are usually covered by their sponsors’ health insurance (co-insurance).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Family members of “Red-White-Red Card” holders, “EU Blue Card” holders or family members of Austrian citizens are usually covered by their sponsors’ health insurance (co-insurance).

requirements.label: Accommodation adequate for the family size by local standards
requirements.description: The test is relative to family size, so what suffices for one applicant may not for another.
requirements.source_excerpt: the third-country national must provide evidence of a legal title to an accommodation (e.g. by providing a lease contract), considered adequate for his/her family size according to local standards.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The third-country national must provide evidence of a legal title to an accommodation (e.g. by providing a lease contract), considered adequate for his/her family size according to local standards.

requirements.label: Valid travel document, waived for a newborn's first application
requirements.description: The waiver is narrow and time-bound: a first application for a child within six months of birth, where the child has no travel document yet.
requirements.source_excerpt: valid travel document. this requirement is waived in the case of first application of a child within six months after birth, if the child does not yet have a valid travel document.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Valid travel document. This requirement is waived in the case of first application of a child within six months after birth, if the child does not yet have a valid travel document.

requirements.label: Evidence or certificate of the family relationship
requirements.description: The document the whole route rests on.
requirements.source_excerpt: evidence or certificate concerning the family relationship
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Evidence or certificate concerning the family relationship
